results.scope: Four pre-existing wallet proofs, two pair wrappers, one merge and one finalizer; fresh typed session and one program cache slot per trial. Excludes wallet proving, networking, consensus and pool scheduling. Not a production throughput or backend speedup claim.

limitations: Aggregation of four pre-existing wallet proofs is not end-to-end transaction processing. Wallet proving, networking, consensus and pool scheduling are excluded.
This experimental explicit CUDA session is not connected to public worker/pool routing.
Only one desktop RTX 5080, one four-thread worker and the pinned four-entry capacity-64 case were measured. Results do not qualify larger batches, V100 execution or multiple GPUs.
Fresh program preparation is included. Warm-cache isolated phase timings from correctness checks are not converted into a sustained transaction rate.
No matched CPU/OpenCL performance baseline was run at this commit; no backend speedup is claimed.
